ADM-001: Admin console loads for admin; an NGO user opening /admin/dashboard is redirected to /unauthorized.
ADM-002: Fresh NGO whose certificate names another organisation → shown AT RISK, approval refused in UI and API → NGO clicks “Replace your documents” (form prefilled) → re-analysis DOCUMENTS CLEAN → admin approves → NGO verified (defect D1 fixed).
ADM-003: Fresh CSR donor; admin Verify Organisation + Verify PAN; donor then passes the funder gate.
ADM-004: Admin “Request re-verification” → NGO dashboard shows the re-verification banner with reason and due date → admin re-decides → banner clears.
ADM-005: Requirement with structured FCRA-required flag excludes FCRA-ineligible NGOs; “see why” shows the rule explanation.
ADM-006: Invite refused before admin review; admin excludes one candidate, reorders and approves the shortlist; ranks persist; excluded NGO cannot be invited.
ADM-007: Creating a contract linked to a requirement before proposal selection is refused (400).
ADM-008: Donor records a payment in the UI, NGO confirms; committed vs reconciled shown separately; receivable schedule per milestone.
ADM-009: NGO uploads a bank statement with a mistyped UTR → admin runs reconciliation → “Bank transfer (UTR) not matched” exception → Match to payment → contract funded (defect D5 fixed).
ADM-010: Same idempotency key replayed → 200 replayed, no second payment row; unsigned webhook rejected (400/503).
ADM-011: Admin approves milestone allocation lines in /admin/allocations; a second decision returns 409; milestones FUNDED (defect D4 fixed).
ADM-012: Admin evidence queue lists field photos; signed photo renders; admin approves (defect D2 fixed).
ADM-013: Duplicate and GPS-mismatch photos are flagged; approving over a flag requires a note; Return to NGO works.
ADM-014: Baseline 42% and endline 61% claims approved in /admin/impact-review; NGO report shows +19 pp.
ADM-015: Consent-filtered funder story generated → admin publishes → visible to the funder.
ADM-016: Grievance Triage → Start investigating → Resolve with outcome note.
ADM-017: Live audit hash chain verifies OK; exported CSV uploaded back verifies OK; tampered export detected (see NEG-013).
ADM-018: Failed job lands in the dead-letter queue → “Replay once” runs the real job → REPLAYED; a second replay returns 409.
ADM-019: Another NGO receives 403/404 on Akshar’s contract, payments, project update, photo and tasks.
ADM-020: Support admin blocked (BREAK_GLASS_REQUIRED) → opens a reasoned, time-boxed grant → access → revoke → 403 again.
NEG-001: Role gates enforced across admin/NGO/donor, including read-only Auditor and Finance admin sub-roles.
NEG-002: Cross-organisation isolation enforced centrally; another NGO cannot read or modify org-owned records.
NEG-003: Beneficiary consent withdrawal hides the photo from the funder and invalidates previously issued links.
NEG-004: Prompt-injection text inside an uploaded RFP is flagged; submission blocked (409 FLAGS_UNCONFIRMED) until a human confirms; eligibility rules unaffected.
NEG-005: Replayed payment request is idempotent — no duplicate record.
NEG-006: Over-payment beyond the unpaid balance refused (422); allocation-level over-allocation refused.
NEG-007: Contract side door before proposal approval refused server-side.
NEG-008: Re-used image flagged as duplicate in the evidence queue.
NEG-009: Photo with GPS far from the project site flagged as GPS mismatch.
NEG-010: Where evidence is missing the impact view shows INSUFFICIENT_DATA — no invented figures.
NEG-011: Donor WhatsApp opt-out honoured; notification falls back to email/in-app and each attempt is logged.
NEG-012: Dead-letter item replays exactly once; second replay refused.
NEG-013: Tampered audit export is detected (HASH_MISMATCH at the edited row).
NEG-014: Donor-facing pages and APIs never expose admin notes, risk scores or AI scores.
NEG-015: Signed photo links are per-viewer and expiring; a tampered link is rejected; revoked link returns 404.
AI-001: RFP PDF upload extracted by Claude with values and per-field confidence (defect D3 fixed).
AI-002: RFP with two conflicting budget figures raises a blocking “Conflicting budget figures” flag for human confirmation.
AI-003: Ranking is explainable: score, coverage and per-dimension reasons shown.
AI-004: FCRA hard rule overrides any similarity score; exclusion reason visible.
AI-005: Proposal-assist draft generated for an invited NGO; budget and milestone amounts left empty for the NGO to fill.
AI-006: AI flags evidence, a human decides; overriding a flag is recorded with the flag codes.
AI-007: Impact story generated from the UI from approved data.
AI-008: Public story excludes funder-only and non-consented beneficiary material.
AI-009: Every AI call is recorded with provider, model, latency and outcome on /admin/ai-telemetry.
AI-010: Admin fault injection forces an AI timeout; the UI shows “AI unavailable — human review required” instead of an error or invented output.
